actionAdapters.when: 只读生成 install-latest 或 upgrade-latest 的一次性计划
用户确认精确计划且 manifest、lock、registry 与远端版本均未漂移后提交一次写入与 Resolve
UPM 更新、编译和 domain reload 稳定后只读核验安装或升级结果，不自动重放
direct dependency 卸载已拆为含 Destructive 的独立 Action；当前 MCP 不开放，必须返回可信审批阻断

allow: Packages/manifest.json direct dependency and scoped registry changes described by the confirmed plan
Packages/packages-lock.json updates produced only by Unity Package Manager Resolve
deny: com.solotopia.nova.framework self install, upgrade or uninstall
fixed historical version, downgrade, arbitrary registry, git/file/registry source switch or batch upgrade
manual packages-lock edits, cache deletion or automatic replay after failure
SDK or Kit enablement, ConfigMaster, Samples, business source, Bundle, Player, UPM publish or Git operations

requiredFor: every install-latest, upgrade-latest or uninstall-direct execution
the exact action, packageName, currentVersion, targetVersion and selected configured registry
the exact manifest and scoped registry diff
delete, external write, credential use, Git commit or push
confirmation.rule: Plan 只读；确认只绑定一次性 planId 及其精确输入和前置指纹。manifest、lock、远端版本、registry 状态或 Editor domain 任一变化后旧确认失效，必须重新计划。

evidence: 只读 Plan 中冻结的动作、包名、当前版本、目标版本、registry、依赖和消费者
用户针对一次性 planId 的明确确认
Execute 返回的 partial receipt，且没有自动重放
Unity 稳定后 manifest 与 packages-lock 的精确版本和 registry 来源，或卸载后的双重消失证据
未执行 SDK/Kit 启用、Sample、业务改动、构建、发布或 Git 操作的边界说明
